FN-YF736N2-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 214
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Jay Hovey
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/15/2024
Senate Bill 214 as introduced would increase the obligations of the State General Fund,
beginning in Fiscal Year 2025, by $148,550 for each state death benefit payment paid to a
surviving beneficiary or dependent of a volunteer firefighter that dies as a result of a
work-related cancer, under certain conditions.
